subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Riverside Community Garden is located in downtown Portland, Oregon.
• It is maintained by local volunteers and neighborhood residents.
• The garden was established by the city council in 1985.
• Its mission is stated in city records: "To provide urban residents with accessible green space for growing food, building community connections, and promoting sustainable agriculture practices."
prompt: The student wants to emphasize how long the garden has existed. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Riverside Community Garden in Portland is maintained by local volunteers and neighborhood residents who established it.
choices.B: According to city records, the Riverside Community Garden (founded in the 1980s) works to "provide urban residents with accessible green space."
choices.C: Community building has been one of the central goals of the Riverside Community Garden from its establishment.
choices.D: The Riverside Community Garden has served downtown Portland since 1985.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. This choice effectively uses information from the notes to emphasize how long the garden has existed. It says that the garden has existed since 1985.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. This choice doesn't emphasize how long the garden has existed. It doesn't say when the garden was established.
